item.title: Introduction
item.description:
Use the overview below to learn about this website, the creator, and how to use it.

It’s recommended to read these in order. But definitely not required.

item.title: Why use this website?
item.description: For any skill, there are many books and tutorials. The number of “learning websites”, both free and paid, both high-quality and amateurish, is near infinite.

item.title: How to use this website
item.description: This is a tutorial website. It provides courses which usually have 10–30 articles (or “tutorials”) inside. These aim to teach you how to do something from start to end.

item.title: About
item.description: Hi! I’m Pandaqi. My real name is Tiamo Pastoor. I’m a guy passionate about games, music, being creative, and trying to get the most out of life.

item.title: Contact
item.description: I’m old-school. Mail me at harmonize@pandaqi.com. All my other websites have a custom email address too, all of which are called “harmonize”!

item.title: The history of this website
item.description:
I have always struggled my way through school by writing my own tutorials.

Textbooks were very dry, contained lots of irrelevant information to comb through, and did a terrible job actually explaining information.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: Welcome to the FAQ! Where we pretend I get these questions all the time, instead of them being things that confused one person sometime in the past decennium. (This website has been online for some time.)

item.title: Roadmap
item.description: This is a passion project. I don’t make any money off of it and don’t intend to. I wanted to share knowledge with the world, help others, create a nice place for all that.

item.description: This is the article linked from the front page, about my mission statement (“free education for all”) and resources that align with it.
